title: The chain-level separability retraction on sheaf tensors
statement: Let F -> B be an arbitrary field extension on a small site, with the comparison interfaces [def-pur-finite-field-derived-tensor-comparison]. If e in B tensor_F B satisfies mu(e)=1 and (b tensor 1 - 1 tensor b)e=0 for every b, then the canonical balanced quotient of total tensor complexes has a natural section whose other composite is the natural e-action. The coefficient action and balanced quotient have the specified pure-generator formulas in every bidegree. Neither derived categories nor finiteness of fields or boundedness of complexes is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain the coefficient action, canonical balanced quotient and its section on module sheaves from the underived separability lemma. These maps are natural and have the prescribed formulas on pure tensor sections.

The proved preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf instance gives preservation of the smallest colimits by the module-sheaf forgetful functors, which reflect colimits. A private helper for arbitrary ring sheaves deduces preservation by scalar restriction. Four proved generic zero-preservation lemmas supply the totalization instances. The existing total-bifunctor comparison gives the natural totalization isomorphisms. All raw totalization arguments are proved for arbitrary categories before specialization. A predicate parameterized by the whole canonical model transports the result along model_eq, carrying dependent endomorphism-ring instances and inclusions together.

Apply a natural transformation of bifunctors in every bidegree and use coproduct extensionality to prove preservation of identities, composition, addition and zero. Lift the tensor-ring action and both split identities, and conjugate by the comparison isomorphisms. Transport this complete result to the canonical totalization models, which are fixed by equality to the Mathlib constructions. Evaluation on their bidegree inclusions proves the action and balanced-quotient generator formulas. The concrete sheaf specialization uses the model API without expanding the chosen coproducts.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YU and the proved source-library total-bifunctor comparison. The ordinary sheaf retraction is isolated in lem-pur-separable-field-tensor-sheaf. Small-colimit preservation follows from the proved forgetful-functor instance. Generic totalization, zero-preservation, equality transport of the complete canonical model, and summand combination are proved privately in the same chain module; the model equality fixes all data to the concrete Mathlib construction.

theorem exists_separableFieldTensorChain (e : B ⊗[F] B)
    (hμ : Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' F e = 1)
    (he : ∀ b : B, (b ⊗ₜ[F] (1 : B) - (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[F] b) * e = 0) :
    ∃ (chain : ChainComparison (J := J) (F := F) (B := B))
      (a : (B ⊗[F] B) →+* End
        (((restrictComplex J F B).prod (restrictComplex J F B)) ⋙ total J F))
      (s : total J B ⋙ restrictComplex J F B ⟶
        ((restrictComplex J F B).prod (restrictComplex J F B)) ⋙ total J F),
      s ≫ chain.chainBalanced = 𝟙 _ ∧
      chain.chainBalanced ≫ s = a e ∧
      ∀ (K L : Complexes J B) (x : B ⊗[F] B),
        (a x).app (K, L) = chain.chainAction K L x
